error: The headline claim says its population is all orders, while the spec and its own caveats say delivered orders.
warning_texts: analysis/claim_register.json labels CLM-NET-REVENUE's population as all orders in the period, but the number covers delivered orders only; a reader who trusts the label would take cancelled and pending orders as included, and under that reading the headline would be 41881.34 rather than 35741.52.

gate_claims_machine has no rule that reads a claim's population or period text: claims_recomputed takes its filters from audit/check_plan.json rather than from the register, and caveats_declared matches only the caveats list, so a claim can be relabelled with a wrong population and still pass all 39

The population and period fields of all five claims were therefore checked only by this auditor's reading; the other four population labels and all five periods agree with how the values were actually computed.
summary: All five claim values match an independent Decimal recompute from raw_data/orders.csv. Country parts add up to the headline, and the refund rate is 27/57 paying customers. But CLM-NET-REVENUE's population field says 'all orders inside the period' while its value is computed on delivered orders only. Under that label the figure would be 41881.34, not 35741.52. The claim's own caveat ('delivered orders only') contradicts the field. No machine rule compares the population text, so the gate passed it.
